name: Keening Wraith

abilities.name: Soul Siphon
abilities.description: Rips a wisp of life from a hero within 5. On a hit, the wraith and every ally within 3 of it heal 2d6+2.

description: Support healer. Keep it within 3 of the monster it's sustaining; its heal only lands if Soul Siphon hits.

name: Crimson Plague Doctor

abilities.name: Blood Transfusion
abilities.description: Pumps stolen blood into itself or an ally within 6, healing 3d8+4.

description: Support healer with the biggest single-target heal. Hangs back at range 6 from the monster it's sustaining.

name: Skullbone Shaman

abilities.name: Bone Totem
abilities.description: Plants a bone totem within 4. At the start of each of the next 2 player phases, it heals the shaman's allies within 2 for 2d6+2.

abilities.name: Ancestral Ward
abilities.description: Calls ancestor spirits around an ally within 5. The ally's next hit taken is halved.

description: Support healer. Drop a Bone Totem next to the monster it's sustaining (a 2×2 or 3×3 monster only needs one square inside the radius), then alternate totems and wards.
